case_title: LEIVA, MARIO VS FAST SERVICE AUTO REPAIR

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY LEIVA, MARIO AS TO DEFENDANT FAST SERVICE AUTO REPAIR ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-16-1999 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF LEIVA, MARIO IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT FAST SERVICE AUTO REPAIR PROOS OF SERVICE WAIVED. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
